description: The HR-95 RTO serves the Sampla sub-division within the Rohtak district of Haryana. It operates under the Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil) acting as the Registering Authority for vehicle registration and driver licensing services. This office is significant for providing localized transport administration to the semi-urban and rural clusters in the Sampla block.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Sampla, Rohtak District, Haryana
